content.text: Warranty section is fully developed. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. Vendor warrants professional and workmanlike performance by qualified personnel to industry standards (19.1), material conformity of Deliverables to documentation and acceptance criteria for ninety days after the later of delivery or acceptance, with hosted Services conforming throughout the subscription term (19.2) — a period at least as protective as the preferred 12-month software / 90-day services benchmark. Section 19.3 adds no-malicious-code, Applicable Law compliance, no functionality diminution and open-source protection. Section 19.4 gives the full remedy ladder (re-perform, repair or replace, then terminate and refund Fees paid) and preserves non-exclusivity for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims, reinforced by Sections 9.5 and 30.2. The disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranties. No redline needed.
